name: maidog
description: Render Mermaid diagrams as Unicode art in your terminal markdown viewer.
author: Elber Ribeiro <elber@dynaum.com>

scripts.bundle: bun build src/cli.ts --target node --minify --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile dist/maidog.js
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run bundle && git diff --exit-code dist/maidog.js
